taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-08 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-08
Curve type: HAK-type
Aquifer depth: 4.98 – 12.61 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity second layer (217.6 ohm-m) between ~5 m and ~12.6 m depth as the primary aquifer zone; advance drilling to at least 13 m with appropriate casing through the overlying layer to secure the borehole before screening the saturated interval.
